sources.scope: Locate applicable voting/register instructions and election-specific decisions; identify version.

sources.title: RIK laws catalogue
sources.scope: Election law, voter-register law, ZUP and administrative-disputes law; follow current documents/amendments.

sources.title: RIK current election information
sources.scope: Identify current election timetable and overseas polling-place decision. Do not infer an election deadline from the homepage alone.

sources.title: RIK 2026 overseas polling-place decision
sources.scope: Published 2026-10-05, decision 013-319/26-3, for parliamentary elections on 2026-10-25. Public overseas polling places, not individual assignment or mission-coverage mapping. Read with RIK-2026-OVERSEAS-AMENDMENT and check later amendments; visually inspect scanned pages.

sources.title: RIK 2026 overseas voting-hours decision
sources.scope: Published 2026-10-05, decision 013-411/26, for parliamentary elections on 2026-10-25. Country table gives local start AND end dates/times, potentially crossing midnight; not a single-date or Belgrade-time assumption. Visually inspect scanned table and check later changes.

sources.title: RIK 2026 overseas polling-place amendment
sources.scope: Published 2026-10-07, decision 013-319/26-7, for parliamentary elections on 2026-10-25. Amendments to RIK-2026-OVERSEAS-PLACES, not a standalone complete list or individual assignment. Read both together, visually inspect scanned pages and check later amendments.

sources.title: MDULS current voter-register instructions
sources.scope: Point 8: competent municipal/city administration issues a separate polling-place decision and delivers it through the diplomatic-consular mission to inform the voter. Distinct from the voting invitation. Check current instruction and amendments at use.

sources.title: Law on the Election of Members of Parliament
sources.scope: Parliamentary elections, articles 85–86: voting invitation delivered no later than five days before voting; foreign voter invitation delivered through the diplomatic-consular mission. This is not the polling-place decision delivery deadline. Read with RIK-MP-LAW-AMENDMENT-2026 and check later amendments.

sources.title: 2026 amendments to the Law on the Election of Members of Parliament
sources.scope: 2026 amendment to RIK-MP-LAW; articles 85–86 are unchanged. Read with the base law and check later amendments; no extension of parliamentary invitation rules to other elections without checking their applicable law.

sources.title: RIK-hosted register instructions PDF
sources.scope: Retrieved PDF cites 15/2012 and 88/2018. Historical reference; not established as current after later amendments.

sources.title: ZUP on an official municipal site
sources.scope: General procedure, representation, receipt, filing and silence-appeal research. Check special election provisions and current amendments.

sources.title: MDULS emergency-era scanned-submission notice
sources.scope: Published 23 March 2020 for the state of emergency; cannot establish current general email-filing validity.

sources.title: Administrative Court registry
sources.scope: Receiving office, address, hours and published email. Email address alone does not establish signature/filing validity.

sources.title: Public voter-register lookup
sources.scope: Read current identity-field requirements before suggesting passport/ID login capability. Do not claim an official lookup was performed without actually doing it.

sources.title: Protector of Citizens complaint resources
sources.scope: Optional separate complaint route; check eligibility, prior remedies and current form. Not a substitute for a timely election remedy.

source_scope: General follow-up research catalogue with labelled official references for parliamentary elections on 2026-10-25; not an active election calendar, polling-place directory, individual case or verified case-specific routing. Original 0.1 reference review date and meaning retained; added references do not establish a fresh global legal review. Reverify official content at use.
